bvi_barman.text: No dock, no pier, no quay. The first customers swam in and paid with wet money, and the Soggy Dollar was born.
A Painkiller: rum, pineapple, orange and cream of coconut, grated nutmeg on top. Invented here, they say. Others say otherwise. Others are wrong.

bvi_swimmer.text: I swam in with a twenty-dollar note between my teeth. It's still damp. He still took it.
Jost Van Dyke's got about three hundred people and more bars than street lights. Nobody minds.
